tier2_seven_type_table_definedtermset._note: Optional addition to /types. The page already carries ItemList. DefinedTermSet describes the 7 types as a named vocabulary, which is a better fit for a comparison table than ItemList alone. Safe to run alongside the existing ItemList.
tier2_seven_type_table_definedtermset.name: The 7 Procrastination Types
tier2_seven_type_table_definedtermset.description: A seven-type model of procrastination drawn from Ferrari (1991), Chu & Choi (2005), Steel (2007), and Sirois & Pychyl (2013).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Arousal Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays to create the pressure they believe they need in order to perform.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Avoidant Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays to avoid the fear of failure or of being judged.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Decisional Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays because committing to a choice feels riskier than making none.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Perfectionist Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays starting and finishing because nothing meets the standard.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Passive Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays without deciding to, through disorganisation and a weak sense of time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Active Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays deliberately and still delivers on time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Emotion-Regulation Procrastinator
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delays to escape an uncomfortable feeling the task brings up.
